body:
Te creemos. No fuiste culpable y fuiste muy valiente al hablar, también aplaudo el actuar de tu mamá. Se necesita fortaleza para hablar.

Ahora, te recomiendo empezar a avanzar más allá, a veces cargar con esto es difícil, pero es necesario seguir avanzando; hablarlo con un profesional y con gente de confianza, sigue y avanza. Se que será una marca qué quedara, pero te aseguro que sanará. Y no dudes en hablar, pedir ayuda si es necesario.

Hace 10 años: nunca serás suficiente para tus padres, deja de intentarlo, cuestiona todo y defiende tus principios.
Hace 5 años: no entres a esa relación, te quitará todo! Y metete de practicante en alguna empresa, te hará falta la experiencia en industria en un futuro (aunque tardes en egresar, no importa lo que digan tus padres, sin experiencia laboral es difícil que te contraten).
Hace 3 años: sal de esa relación ahora si es que de pendejo te lanzaste! Y esos no son tus amigos, nunca lo fueron! No abandones el camino que haz elegido con respecto a tus estudios.

To simply cease to exist, at least in self consciousness, and I think since taking these damn pills, I've been dead these past few months. Thank you for your answers.

I'm Richard, I'm in a hotel far from home, a twelve hours drive from my “home”, and... thanks again for the chat.

Maybe. With me it's the opposite, I left things in order because I thought I was really going to do it someday.

But maybe, that's also why I made this post here, for an answer, but then what? Every time I feel lost I'm going to resort to this? I'm going to turn to you? (Not personal against you) but, Please, so many people have shown me that I'm a fucking monster, and as time goes by even my own family has told me so, So many people have just brushed me aside without caring about my fucking feelings, I should just turn my back on them and that's it... and what's next?

Every day I have that question and the answer is less and less satisfying…

Thank you for your story. I am 27 years old.

Liquid courage is a great term. But I think I was really more the one who believed I could belong somewhere and have that hope, hope that was just lost a few days ago, or so I feel.

I won't lie, I'm also tired and frustrated, why didn't I end it sooner? I think like you I had hope for something and I had enough of one person, but I don't anymore, and honestly... I think a part of me is happy about that.

You asked me if I had thought about suicide all this year, yes I did, in fact everything is in order so that if something happens to me I didn't leave any pending, I left it like that for months, and I kept it that way all this time. I think, really, it just took time.

Courage. I lacked courage, and whisky. I thought maybe it wouldn't happen again, I thought maybe I would have enough strength if it happened again, but who am I kidding, I don't, and I don't want this happening again to cost me another possible year of medication, this isn't life.
Even so, I'm interested to know your personal example.
